outcome.description:
How the medium engine's run ended, when it reports it. A failure (or a cancel, or a time-out)
makes the scan `forced` with nothing preselected even when the program is gone; a success is
never believed on its own: the broker's own verify-gone still decides. It can only make the
scan safer.

oneOf.description: Exit code 0. A success *candidate*: [`VerifyGone`] decides whether the app is really gone.
Exit code 1605: the product was not installed any more.
Exit code 1641 or 3010: success, a restart is needed.
Any other exit code, or the command could not be started.
The wait for the process tree gave up.
